items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: John Veeam was a jazz drummer all his life. The same stuff that the guys is doing right now, John Veeam was doing that years and years ago.

ctx.x: You remember Mac Murray's real name?

Well, John Veeam. John Veeam was a jazz drummer all his life. The same stuff that the guys is doing right now, John Veeam was doing that years and years ago. That shuffle beat, see? But didn't know nothing about it.
